purpose: Bounded historical engineering-decision reconstruction; not a representative benchmark
selection_method: GitHub search API: created before 2024, substantial comment counts; purposive selection for API design debates, rejected options and linked implementation PRs. No newest-first crawl.
selection_bias: High-discussion purposive sample; not suitable for estimating repository-wide decision prevalence or extraction accuracy.

items.reason: Retry policy and scope of transport vs application behavior
Certificate trust store defaults and portability alternatives
Overall response timeout vs per-operation timeouts
Transport API design and concrete code changes
Removing rfc3986 dependency and URL implementation tradeoffs
LineDecoder semantics vs stdlib splitlines performance

coverage_policy: Record every failed discussion or missing collection; no silent truncation. Source payload hashes and retrieval timestamps are stored in Neon. Current source snapshots may include later comments.
